cutout_prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: one aligned transparent PNG layer for a layered PSD.
Input image: edit target, original 1024 x 1536 full-body anime character. The original canvas is the coordinate system.
Primary request: Extract ONLY the front fringe/bangs of the blue-gray hair as a single RGBA layer with a truly transparent background. Retain the front hair cap from the crown around (510,50), across the front forehead, down to the sharp uneven fringe tips above/between the eyes around y=170-190. Preserve the short hair framing the temples where it belongs to the frontal fringe. Exclude the long side/back bob behind the cheeks and neck. This is a pixel-faithful cutout operation, not a new hairstyle.
Constraints: Output must remain 1024 x 1536, with hair at EXACTLY its original canvas coordinates and scale, occupying approximately x=397..604, y=40..203. Do not enlarge, center, crop, move, rotate, redraw or recolor the hair. Preserve the original linework, highlights, strand shapes, color and edge antialiasing. Include only source-visible hair; do not invent hidden hair or skin. All face, eyes, ears, neck, body, clothes, boots, background glow and background pixels must become alpha=0. No rectangular patch, no checkerboard painted into RGB, no extra object, no annotation, no text. Keep empty lower canvas fully transparent.
mask_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a segmentation-mask edit of the input, NOT an illustration.
Input edit target: full-body anime woman, 1024x1536 pixels.
Output: exact same 1024x1536 coordinate canvas, entirely pure black except ONE pure white filled silhouette showing the SOURCE-VISIBLE FRONT BANGS of the character at their ORIGINAL POSITION. Do not draw any hair texture, outlines, background gradient, person, face, eyes, clothing or text. Binary mask only.
White region: frontal blue-gray hair from top of head at x~510 y~35, frontal cap across x~410..596, down to ragged fringes that cross the forehead ending around y~175, and front strands at the temples. Exclude back/side bob behind cheeks below y~200. Preserve the asymmetrical bangs tips and the forehead opening on viewer's right. Everything outside this visible frontal hair region is black. White silhouette must match the original hair boundary pixel-for-pixel, without shifting, resizing, centering or extending hidden parts. Do NOT draw a larger isolated hairstyle. No transparency required; black/white opaque mask. Empty remainder of body canvas pure black.
result: Direct generated cutout rejected. Generated mask used as a visual reference only; final mask was reviewed and traced on source.
